title: "1 · Scientific Discovery: from AI to Deep Learning"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

Learning models from data is as old as science: Babylonian sky observations, Tycho's measurements, Kepler's laws, Newton's gravity and Einstein's principles, and a graph neural network that rediscovers Newton's law of gravity. Classical data and quantum correlations as new resources; the landscape from artificial intelligence through machine learning to deep learning; the recipe of deep learning; and a tour of discoveries driven by AI, from AlphaFold to AlphaTensor.
